_about: Copy to story_lock.json to use it (read at server start; a world's dmzultra/story_lock.json wins over it). enabled: true/false overrides [forms] storyLock. milestones: move a milestone's quest everywhere (saga:number, DragonMineZ' numbering). rows: race/group.form (* = any race / the whole group) -> a milestone id, saga:number, or - (never locked). The milestones and rows are in the jar under data/dmzultra/story_lock; docs/v05/story_lock.md lists them.
